review::.::holistic::cross_module_archit.summary: Supabase runtime client is consumed directly across layers instead of through domain/integration boundaries.

evidence: `useResourceBrowserData` calls `getSupabaseClient().auth.getSession()` directly inside feature UI data orchestration.
Many non-integration modules import `@/integrations/supabase/client` directly (features/domains/shared/tools), turning integration runtime into a global dependency surface.
This pattern bypasses integration-owned repository seams and makes any client/runtime contract change codebase-wide.
detail.suggestion: Introduce integration-owned query/mutation facades (per domain slice), then ban direct imports of `@/integrations/supabase/client` outside `src/integrations/**` via lint rule + staged migration. Keep only bootstrap/auth-guard level accessors as explicit exceptions.

review::.::holistic::cross_module_archit.summary: A single shared error runtime is coupled into integration internals, blending infra and app-layer concerns.

evidence: Integration modules (`createSupabaseClient`, `AuthStateManager`) call `normalizeAndPresentError` from shared runtime error hub.
`runtimeError` routes through `presentRuntimeError`, whose presenter is installed at app bootstrap, so infra modules are coupled to app-level presentation/error policy plumbing.
With 259 importers, this hub centralizes unrelated layer concerns and amplifies architectural blast radius.
detail.suggestion: Split error handling into strict layers: `normalize/report` (infra-safe, no presenter dependency) and `present` (UI/app). Integration code should depend only on infra-safe layer; app/hook boundaries can opt into presentation.

review::.::holistic::cross_module_archit.summary: ImageGenerationForm context and hook module form an explicit 2-file cycle.

evidence: `ImageGenerationFormContext.tsx` re-exports hooks from `hooks/useImageGenerationFormContexts`.
`useImageGenerationFormContexts.ts` imports `ImageGenerationFormContext` back from `../ImageGenerationFormContext`.
Packet dependency evidence reports one existing cycle matching this pair.
detail.suggestion: Break the cycle by moving context token/types into a neutral `contextTypes.ts` (or `contextToken.ts`) and have both files import from that module; keep re-export barrel separate from the context definition file.

review::.::holistic::high_level_elegance.summary: Project state ownership stays ambiguous because legacy combined hook coexists with split-context API.

evidence: `ProjectContext` defines separated Selection/Crud/Identity contexts but still exports `useProject()` that recombines all of them for compatibility.
Consumers are mixed: some use narrow hooks (`useProjectSelectionContext`), while many pages/tools still consume broad `useProject()`.
This keeps dependency boundaries unclear and encourages broad coupling to project subsystem internals.
detail.suggestion: Define a migration end-state and deprecate `useProject()` with phased codemods: migrate consumers to narrow hooks per responsibility, then remove combined facade and enforce API usage by lint rule.

review::.::holistic::cross_module_archit.summary: Dynamic imports are being used as cycle-pressure workarounds in core runtime paths.

evidence: `logger.flushLogs` performs `await import('@/integrations/supabase/client')` with an inline note to avoid circular dependencies.
`AuthStateManager` dynamically imports reconnect scheduler during auth flow, introducing runtime indirection in core integration path.
These deferred imports indicate unresolved dependency direction issues around shared runtime singletons.
detail.suggestion: Extract small, dependency-inverted interfaces for logging transport and reconnect scheduling, inject them at bootstrap, and remove runtime dynamic imports from steady-state paths.

review::.::holistic::error_consistency::.summary: Optimistic reference-update failures are swallowed, then stale data is persisted as success

evidence: `runOptimisticCacheUpdate` wraps `operation()` in try/catch and never rethrows.
Both upload/select handlers call `runOptimisticCacheUpdate(...)` and immediately proceed to `persistReferenceSelection(...)` and then `markAsInteracted()`.
`persistReferenceSelection` snapshots cache state via `queryClient.getQueryData(...)`; if optimistic mutation failed, old state is persisted without surfacing a hard failure.
detail.suggestion: Return an explicit `OperationResult` from `runOptimisticCacheUpdate` and gate persistence/interaction success on `ok`. If optimistic update fails, abort persistence and surface a user-visible recovery path (retry or hard refresh of reference state).

review::.::holistic::error_consistency::.summary: Task-details retrieval/parsing errors are flattened into normal empty-state behavior

evidence: `useGenerationDetails` catches parse exceptions and returns `[]` images with `showToast: false`.
`useGenerationTaskDetails` catches on-demand mapping errors and reports silently (`showToast: false`) while returning task-null states used by UI.
Modal/panel render "No task details available" for `!task`, which is the same output used for genuine absence of task details.
detail.suggestion: Introduce a distinct `failure_state` in task-details contracts (e.g., `status: 'ok' | 'missing' | 'error'`) and render an error-specific UI path when mapping/parse fails. Preserve original error context for telemetry and optional user feedback.

review::.::holistic::mid_level_elegance:.summary: MediaLightbox uses dual boundary shapes (flat and grouped), creating avoidable seam translation

evidence: `types.ts` already defines grouped seam interfaces (`LightboxNavigationProps`, `LightboxShotWorkflowProps`, etc.).
`MediaLightbox.tsx` defines additional flat prop interfaces and reconstructs grouped objects each render before delegation.
This produces two parallel API conventions for the same module boundary, increasing maintenance cost when adding/removing fields.
detail.suggestion: Standardize on grouped seam contracts at the public `MediaLightbox` boundary and remove flat re-mapping interfaces. Keep a single canonical prop shape shared across container and child lightboxes.

review::.::holistic::convention_outlier:.summary: HuggingFace key flow mixes throw/result/success-object conventions without one canonical boundary

evidence: `verifyHuggingFaceToken` never throws and returns `{valid,error}`.
Repository functions (`fetchExternalApiKey`, `saveExternalApiKey`, `deleteExternalApiKey`) throw errors directly.
Hook-level `saveToken` converts again into `{success,error}`, creating convention drift for adjacent callers and tests.
detail.suggestion: Adopt one error contract for this subsystem (prefer `OperationResult` or throw-based with a single adapter at hook boundary). Document and enforce it across verifier, repository, and hook layers.

review::.::holistic::mid_level_elegance:.summary: TaskDetails modal and panel duplicate orchestration logic instead of sharing a seam

evidence: Both components duplicate copy-id/copy-params interactions, detailed-params expand/collapse, loading/empty rendering, and apply-settings controls.
Behavior differences are currently incidental (layout wrapper), not domain-specific, so duplicated orchestration adds synchronization risk when task-details behavior evolves.
detail.suggestion: Extract a shared task-details presenter/controller (state + handlers + common sections) and let modal/panel provide only layout shell concerns.

review::.::holistic::abstraction_fitness.summary: Supabase access abstraction is split between throw-first repositories and result-checked hooks.

evidence: `getSupabaseClient()` throws on uninitialized runtime in `client.ts`, but many repositories call it directly and return raw query builders.
`useTasks.ts` and other hooks use `getSupabaseClientResult()` and add local fallback/error handling, duplicating guard behavior outside repository boundaries.
`useGenerationMutations.ts` must add extra validation/error choreography around thin repository calls, indicating low-leverage indirection.
detail.suggestion: Unify on one data-access contract: either make repositories return normalized `OperationResult` values (non-throwing) or enforce throw-only access and centralize normalization in one adapter layer. Then migrate hooks to that single contract and remove duplicated runtime-init guards.

review::.::holistic::abstraction_fitness.summary: Referral finalization logic is duplicated across hooks with divergent abstractions.

evidence: `useHomeAuth.ts` performs inline referral storage read/cleanup and calls `rpcCreateReferralFromSession` through repository flow.
`useAuthReferralFinalize.ts` separately implements referral read/call/cleanup logic but bypasses `homeAuthRepository.ts` and calls `supabase.rpc` directly.
Two parallel implementations of the same business step create drift risk for behavior, telemetry context, and error policy.
detail.suggestion: Collapse referral finalization into one shared service/hook contract (single storage key policy + single RPC call path) and have both Home auth entry points call that contract instead of maintaining separate implementations.

review::.::holistic::dependency_health::.summary: Image preloading is disabled by realtime connectivity state and drops queued work.

evidence: `PreloadingService.subscribeToConnectionStatus` derives connectivity from `DataFreshnessManager` realtime status, not from image-fetch capability.
`preloadImages()` returns immediately when `isConnected` is false, so transient realtime issues suppress preloading entirely.
`onConnectionStatusChange(false)` clears pending queue items, and no replay mechanism restores cleared work when connection recovers.
detail.suggestion: Decouple preloading eligibility from realtime channel health. Keep preloading active with throttled concurrency during realtime outages, and add a replay buffer so cleared pending preload intents can be retried after reconnect.

review::.::holistic::mid_level_elegance:.summary: Timeline position ownership is fragmented across multiple overlapping core hooks.

evidence: `useTimelineCore.ts` declares itself as timeline position source-of-truth, while `useTimelinePositions.ts` also declares single source-of-truth for positions.
`useTimelineFrameUpdates.ts` introduces a third persistence path for timeline updates that shares queue/RPC dependencies but not state ownership.
This causes seam friction: similar invalidation/persist choreography is repeated in separate modules and coordinated indirectly from container-level composition.
detail.suggestion: Define one authoritative timeline write/read orchestrator (state + persistence + invalidation). Keep UI hooks as adapters over that core API, and move shared persistence semantics (optimistic policy, rollback, refetch) into the single orchestrator.

review::.::holistic::low_level_elegance:.summary: Shot editor controller builds and forwards oversized nested argument bags in one module.

evidence: `useShotEditorController.ts` wires a very large set of settings/actions and constructs a deep `generationControllerInput` object before passing it onward.
`buildShotEditorGenerationControllerInput` only repackages fields without reducing branch/ownership complexity.
Local changes require editing dense wiring regions with many coupled fields, increasing error-prone edits and review burden.
detail.suggestion: Split `useShotEditorController` into focused composition hooks by concern (generation, media management, UI state bridge) and replace broad nested bags with narrower typed contracts created near each consumer.

review::.::holistic::api_surface_coheren.summary: Generation->task mapping has two incompatible public cache key contracts

evidence: `taskQueryKeys` exposes both `generationTaskId(generationId)` and `generationMapping(generationId)`.
`useTaskPrefetch` reads/writes `generationTaskId` while `generationTaskCache` reads/writes `generationMapping` for the same conceptual data (taskId + status).
This duplicates cache entries and allows stale/missing reads depending on which API path populated first.
detail.suggestion: Converge on one canonical key (`generationMapping` or `generationTaskId`) and remove the other. Update all readers/writers and tests to the canonical key, then add a migration test that verifies prefetch and merge paths share the same cache entry.

review::.::holistic::api_surface_coheren.summary: Task cache uses mixed scoped/unscoped keys for the same entity

evidence: `generationTaskCache` prefetches and reads task data with `taskQueryKeys.single(taskId)` (project omitted => `__no-project__`).
`useGetTask` and task prefetch hooks use `taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId)` and query by both `id` and `project_id`.
The mismatch means cross-module consumers can miss prefetched data or read divergent entries for the same task id.
detail.suggestion: Make project scope mandatory for all task-detail cache access and carry `projectId` through `generationTaskCache` APIs. Replace unscoped `single(taskId)` calls with `single(taskId, projectId)` and add contract tests across `generationTaskCache` + `useTasks` + `useTaskPrefetch`.

review::.::holistic::test_strategy::unte.summary: Task-type fetch boundary lacks direct tests despite high fan-out

evidence: No `useTaskType` test file exists under `src/shared/hooks/tasks`.
The hook is used in multiple user-facing components to determine task display behavior.
The hook intentionally collapses error/not-found to `null`, but there is no explicit regression coverage for this contract.
detail.suggestion: Add `useTaskType` tests covering success, DB error, missing row, and cache-init behavior for `useAllTaskTypesConfig`; include one integration-style test from a consuming component to validate UI behavior under each case.

review::.::holistic::test_strategy::stub.summary: Task invalidation tests assert constants while production module is a stub

evidence: `useTaskInvalidation.ts` contains only type/interface declarations (no exported behavior).
The test suite still passes by asserting key literals and direct `queryClient.invalidateQueries` calls, not by invoking a production invalidation API.
This creates false confidence around task invalidation behavior.
detail.suggestion: Either remove the dead module/tests entirely or implement and export real task invalidation functions, then rewrite tests to execute that implementation (including list/detail/counts/all scopes and generation-cascade behavior).

review::.::holistic::mid_level_elegance:.summary: Serialized timeline queue times out callers but cannot stop underlying write work

evidence: `runSerializedTaskWithTimeout` uses timer-based reject but does not pass an abort signal into `task`.
When timeout fires, queue bookkeeping is released in `finally`, allowing next writes to start even if previous async DB operation continues.
Callers depend on queue ordering for timeline correctness; overlapping late completions can reintroduce stale invalidation/refetch churn.
detail.suggestion: Change `runSerializedTimelineWrite` to accept an abortable task signature `(signal) => Promise<T>` and propagate cancellation on timeout. Require all write callers to use abort-aware DB paths, and add a test proving timed-out write side effects cannot complete after queue release.

review::.::holistic::incomplete_migratio.summary: Structure-video migration is stalled by maintaining two concurrent state contracts

evidence: ShotImagesEditorImageState includes legacy single-video fields (primaryStructureVideoPath/type/motion) and new structureVideos array simultaneously.
useStructureVideo exposes both canonical array operations and legacy primary-field accessors in its return type.
taskDataService still resolves structure settings by checking new array first, then multiple legacy top-level aliases.
detail.suggestion: Make `structure_videos` the only internal state contract across editor/timeline code. Move legacy key parsing into one adapter at ingestion boundaries, then remove `primaryStructureVideo*` fields from shared props and context interfaces.

review::.::holistic::incomplete_migratio.summary: Legacy-named default config is still used as canonical runtime source

evidence: defaults.ts defines `DEFAULT_VIDEO_STRUCTURE_PARAMS` with legacy key names (`structure_video_*`) and comment indicates partial support assumptions.
useStructureVideo uses those legacy-key defaults directly when producing canonical structureVideos state and derived accessors.
payloadBuilder rejects implicit legacy fields in canonical mode, so default configuration semantics and canonical payload semantics are still split.
detail.suggestion: Introduce a canonical `DEFAULT_STRUCTURE_VIDEO` object (`treatment`, `motion_strength`, `structure_type`, `uni3c_end_percent`) and derive legacy aliases only inside migration adapters. Replace direct `structure_video_*` default usage in editor hooks.

review::.::holistic::low_level_elegance:.summary: useTimelinePositions is a monolithic state machine with mixed responsibilities

evidence: The hook is 701 LOC and handles sync-from-server, optimistic state mutation, rollback, persistence, locking, queue-guard logic, and trailing endpoint persistence in one file.
It contains lifecycle/compatibility scaffolding and dead/noise artifacts (unused `_queryClient`, empty compatibility section) that indicate high local indirection cost.
Orchestrator-level interaction logic still depends on this mixed hook, coupling UI behavior to persistence internals.
detail.suggestion: Split into focused units: `useTimelinePositionState` (optimistic state + rollback), `useTimelinePositionPersistence` (DB writes + invalidation), and `useTimelinePositionSync` (server merge/guards). Keep `useTimelinePositions` as a thin composition wrapper.

review::.::holistic::ai_generated_debt::.summary: Defensive explanatory scaffolding is drowning signal in timeline/video hooks

evidence: useTimelinePositions includes extensive prose blocks repeating implementation details at many points, plus placeholder section headers without code.
Small hooks with simple behavior include long tutorial-style doc blocks that duplicate obvious control flow.
The pattern increases review overhead and makes true control-path changes harder to spot.
detail.suggestion: Prune comments to invariants and non-obvious race guarantees only; remove empty section scaffolding; keep API docs short and move deeper rationale to a single module-level note if needed.

review::.::holistic::package_organizatio.summary: `src/shared/hooks` mixes generic UI hooks with generation/task data-access hooks, blurring package boundaries.

evidence: `useFileDragTracking.ts` is a generic drag-state utility, while `useLineageChain.ts` contains Supabase lineage traversal and project scope validation in the same directory.
`useShareGeneration.ts` and `usePendingGenerationTasks.ts` execute DB/auth queries from the same package that also holds local UI interaction hooks.
Directory profile: `src/shared/hooks/` has 48 files and imports from both `src/shared/lib/` (30 edges) and `src/integrations/supabase/` (21 edges), signaling mixed layer ownership.
detail.suggestion: Staged reorg plan: Stage 1 create target folders `src/domains/generation/hooks/` and `src/domains/task/hooks/`; Stage 2 move data-centric hooks first (`useLineageChain`, `usePendingGenerationTasks`, `useShareGeneration`) into domain folders while keeping temporary re-export shims in `src/shared/hooks/`; Stage 3 move remaining domain hooks (variants/shot-generation/task-*); Stage 4 keep `src/shared/hooks/` for cross-domain UI/interaction-only hooks. After each stage run import updates via `rg -l "@/shared/hooks/use(LineageChain|PendingGenerationTasks|ShareGeneration)" src` and replace paths, then validate with `npm run typecheck` and `npm test -- useLineageChain`.

review::.::holistic::package_organizatio.summary: `src/shared/lib` combines generic helpers and domain repositories/caches, reducing directory cohesion.

evidence: Generic browser/file helpers (`clipboard.ts`, `fileConversion.ts`) are co-located with generation/task persistence and query-cache orchestration (`generationTaskCache.ts`, `generationTaskRepository.ts`).
`generationTaskCache.ts` depends on Supabase client and task query keys, i.e., domain/integration behavior rather than shared primitive utility.
Directory profile: `src/shared/lib/` has 54 files and is heavily imported by diverse directories, which increases blast radius of changes in a nominally 'shared' package.
detail.suggestion: Staged reorg plan: Stage 1 create `src/domains/generation/repository/`, `src/domains/task/repository/`, and `src/shared/utils/browser/`; Stage 2 move `generationTaskCache.ts`, `generationTaskRepository.ts`, `taskRowMapper.ts` into domain repository folders; Stage 3 move generic helpers (`clipboard.ts`, `fileConversion.ts`) into `shared/utils/browser`; Stage 4 leave compatibility exports in `src/shared/lib/index` for one release, then remove. Update imports with `rg -l "@/shared/lib/(generationTaskCache|generationTaskRepository|taskRowMapper|clipboard|fileConversion)" src` and validate using `npm run typecheck` plus focused tests `npm test -- generationTaskCache`.

review::.::holistic::high_level_elegance.summary: MediaLightbox hooks package has become a multi-purpose subsystem hub with unclear ownership boundaries.

evidence: Directory profile reports 49 files / 9605 LOC for one hooks package, with inbound/outbound coupling across shared hooks/lib/media, domain types, and integrations.
`index.ts` exposes a broad mixed-scope API (edit orchestration, persistence, task detail hooks, video mode hooks), making ownership and dependency intent hard to infer.
`buildImageEditStateValue.ts` and `editSettingsTypes.ts` sit together despite representing different layers (state assembly orchestration vs durable settings model).
This package is consumed from both MediaLightbox components and external tool hooks (`src/tools/edit-images/hooks/`), confirming it acts as a cross-feature bucket.
detail.suggestion: Staged reorg plan: Stage 1 split `src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/hooks/` into subpackages `hooks/orchestration/`, `hooks/modes/`, `hooks/persistence/`, and `model/` (for settings types); Stage 2 move files in dependency-safe order: types/models first (`editSettingsTypes.ts`), then pure state builders (`buildImageEditStateValue.ts`), then mode hooks, then orchestration hooks (`useSharedLightboxState.ts`, controller-level hooks); Stage 3 replace broad barrel with scoped entrypoints (`hooks/modes/index.ts`, `hooks/orchestration/index.ts`) and keep a temporary deprecated root barrel. Update imports via `rg -l "@/shared/components/MediaLightbox/hooks" src` and validate with `npm run typecheck` and `npm test -- MediaLightbox/hooks`.

review::.::holistic::initialization_coup.summary: Join-clips handoff relies on ambient localStorage queue with init-timing dependent consumption

evidence: `useJoinClips` writes pending clip entries directly to `localStorage` (`localStorage.getItem`/`setItem`) using queue keys from `getPendingJoinClipsStorageKey`.

`useClipManager` consumes pending clips in an effect gated by `settingsLoaded`, `selectedProjectId`, and `initialHydrationComplete`; once those are stable, later queue writes are not automatically observed.
`consumePendingJoinClips` destructively removes queue keys after read, so behavior depends on which consumer instance initializes first.
detail.suggestion: Replace the ambient queue with a dedicated `JoinClipsIntentStore` (React-query cache slice or context-backed registry) that provides `enqueue`, `subscribe`, and `ack` semantics. Keep localStorage only as persistence fallback behind that store, and trigger consumption through explicit store events rather than init-only effects.

review::.::holistic::design_coherence::s.summary: Upload feedback state is decoupled from mutation outcome, causing misleading UI transitions

evidence: `dispatchAppEvent('shot-pending-upload', ...)` is fired before `addImageToShotMutation`/`positionExistingGenerationMutation` resolves (`useGalleryPageState.ts:148-166`).

`SortableShotItem` immediately enters loading state on this event and infers completion from image-count deltas/timeouts (`SortableShotItem.tsx:195-215`, `:116-143`, `:162-179`), not from actual mutation result.
On mutation failure path in `useGalleryPageState`, no compensating event or rollback signal is emitted, so the drop indicator can display loading/success despite failure.
detail.suggestion: Move shot-upload feedback to a single transaction model: emit `started/succeeded/failed` events (or, better, share mutation status via central state) keyed by operation id. Update `SortableShotItem` from explicit operation state instead of inferred count/timeouts.

review::.::holistic::design_coherence::l.summary: Image lightbox orchestration aggregates too many concerns into one unstable control surface

evidence: `ImageLightbox` builds and threads large composite models (`env`, `sharedModel`, `editModel`, `renderModel`) with broad dependency arrays, mixing concerns: variant lifecycle, shot workflows, edit orchestration, task detail panels, layout, and navigation (`ImageLightbox.tsx:340-862`).

`useSharedLightboxState` exports a very wide return contract containing variants/navigation/star/references/lineage/shot creation/source generation/layout/button groups, increasing coupling pressure across callers.
`useInlineEditState` mirrors similar broad orchestration for edit modes/persistence/variants/lora/upscale, indicating repeated controller-aggregation pattern rather than bounded feature seams.
detail.suggestion: Introduce bounded feature controllers with narrow interfaces (e.g., `variantController`, `editController`, `shotController`, `panelController`) and compose them via a typed coordinator that only exposes stable cross-cutting contracts. This should remove wide prop bags and reduce re-render churn from unrelated concern changes.

review::.::holistic::initialization_coup.summary: Tool settings auth cache is not cleared on sign-out, allowing stale user identity during initialization-time settings fetch.

evidence: `toolSettingsService.ts` keeps module-level `cachedUser`/`cachedUserAt` and `getCachedUserId()` returns cache first when within `USER_CACHE_MS`.
`AuthContext.tsx` calls `setCachedUserId(currentUserId)` only when `currentUserId` is truthy; no symmetric cache-clear path exists for signed-out transitions.
`useToolSettings.ts` uses `getCachedUserId()` for fetch initialization, so stale cache directly affects scope/user resolution.
detail.suggestion: Add an explicit `clearCachedUserId()` API in `toolSettingsService` and call it on signed-out/null-session transitions in `AuthContext`; additionally key or invalidate inflight settings fetches on auth change to prevent stale completion writes.

review::.::holistic::design_coherence::f.summary: Auth/session lifecycle logic is duplicated across multiple hooks/components instead of a single orchestration boundary.

evidence: `AuthContext` performs session bootstrap plus auth event debouncing/subscription.
`useHomeAuth` independently performs session fetch, hash-token session restoration, subscription, redirect decisions, and referral linking.
`useGlobalHeaderAuth` independently fetches session, subscribes to auth changes, and drives user-related derived fetches.
Each module owns overlapping auth initialization concerns with distinct timing and side effects, increasing drift risk.
detail.suggestion: Introduce a single auth lifecycle service/provider exposing normalized auth state and event phases (initial session restored, signed-in, signed-out), and move page/header-specific reactions to pure subscribers with no duplicate session bootstrap logic.

review::.::holistic::design_coherence::h.summary: `useHomeAuth` bundles unrelated concerns (OAuth parsing, PWA routing, referral side effects, and auth listening) into one effect-heavy controller.

evidence: Single hook manages URL hash parsing, `setSessionFromTokens`, immediate/delayed `fetchCurrentSession`, standalone detection, redirect policy, and referral RPC sequencing.
Nested async closures and localStorage flags (`oauthInProgress`, referral keys) are embedded directly in auth event callback paths.
Behavior overlaps with other auth consumers, indicating this hook acts as both policy engine and low-level transport client.
detail.suggestion: Split into composable units: token-restoration adapter, auth state subscription hook, and navigation policy hook; keep referral linking in a dedicated post-signin effect/service with explicit success/failure contract.

review::.::holistic::design_coherence::s.summary: Monolithic generated Supabase type module creates high coupling and low navigability for domain code.

evidence: `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` remains 2576 LOC.
Both low-level runtime and higher-level domain hooks import from the same large type surface (`Database`, `Json`).
Mechanical complexity hotspot includes this file and adjacent modules, indicating centralization pressure.
detail.suggestion: Decompose exported type surface into stable domain-specific type entrypoints (e.g., `types/json.ts`, `types/database-public.ts`, generated base kept internal), then migrate imports to narrow modules to reduce transitive type coupling.

review::.::holistic::design_coherence::c.summary: Clip duration hydration runs uncancelled async updates that can apply after state/context shifts, creating coherence drift in clip state.

evidence: The `useEffect` for `getClipsNeedingDuration(clips)` launches `forEach(async clip => ...)` with no cancellation/version guard.
On project or clip list changes, late `loadClipDuration` resolutions still call `setClips`, potentially writing stale metadata flags/durations into newer state.
Earlier hydration effects in the same file already use request-version guards, but duration loading path does not, showing inconsistent orchestration patterns.
detail.suggestion: Apply the same versioning/cancellation strategy used in hydration effects to duration-loading updates (request token ref + stale-check before `setClips`), or move duration hydration into a reducer/state machine that rejects stale actions.

review::.::holistic::initialization_coup.summary: Realtime connection is instantiated as a module singleton with constructor side effects, coupling runtime behavior to import timing.

evidence: `RealtimeConnection.ts` exports `realtimeConnection = new RealtimeConnection()` at module scope.
Constructor immediately registers window app-event listener (`realtime:auth-heal`) when `window` exists.
Provider and other imports consume this singleton directly, so initialization semantics are implicit rather than controlled via explicit runtime bootstrap.
detail.suggestion: Replace eager singleton export with explicit factory/registry initialization during app bootstrap (similar to Supabase runtime bootstrap), and inject connection instance into provider/context to decouple import order from side-effect registration.

review::.::holistic::authorization_consi.summary: Resource update path leaks ownership/existence details for IDs not owned by caller

evidence: `useUpdateResource` performs an existence probe without `user_id` constraint before auth-scoped verification (`select id,user_id,type where id = ...`).
When ownership check fails it throws differentiated messages (`This resource belongs to another user` vs generic not found), enabling ID probing semantics.
detail.suggestion: Remove the unauthenticated existence probe and always perform a single user-scoped lookup/update. Return a uniform error for both missing and unauthorized resources, and stop logging owner IDs in client-visible error paths.

review::.::holistic::contract_coherence:.summary: Resource listing hooks silently cap results at 20k but expose them as complete lists

evidence: `useListPublicResources` stops when `allData.length >= 20000` by forcing `hasMore = false`; `useListResources` breaks on the same threshold.
Neither hook returns truncation metadata/error; downstream UI/filtering logic assumes completeness and can hide valid resources beyond the cap.
detail.suggestion: Make the contract explicit: either expose cursor/paginated APIs to consumers or return a `truncated` flag/error when the cap is hit. Update `useResourceBrowserData` to handle incomplete datasets explicitly.

review::.::holistic::logic_clarity::rend.summary: Hook mutates state during render to reset pagination, obscuring update flow

evidence: `useResourceBrowserData` compares a ref and executes `setCurrentPage(1)` directly in render when `showMyResourcesOnly` changes (lines 66-70).

This creates render-driven state transitions rather than event/effect-driven transitions, making behavior harder to reason about and increasing risk of accidental re-render loops when adjacent state logic changes.
detail.suggestion: Move page reset into explicit state transition handlers (`toggleMyResourcesFilter`/`clearMyResourcesFilter`) or an effect keyed on `showMyResourcesOnly`.

review::.::holistic::type_safety::unchec.summary: Persisted transform payload is cast to `ImageTransform` without runtime validation

evidence: `useImageTransform` reads `activeVariantParams?.transform as ImageTransform` from `Record<string, unknown>` and only checks `typeof savedTransform === 'object'`.
Values are then consumed numerically in `useCanvasTransform` (`translate`, `scale`, `rotate`) without sanitization, so malformed persisted values can produce invalid transforms/NaN behavior.
detail.suggestion: Introduce a runtime decoder/guard for transform payloads (number finite checks + boolean checks + defaults) and centralize coercion before state hydration.
